draft.title: Tides
card: Tides are the regular rise and fall of the ocean's level. High tide is when the water is at its highest and low tide is when it is at its lowest.
The moon's gravity pulls on the Earth's oceans. This makes the water bulge out on the side facing the moon and on the opposite side. These bulges are high tides.

The sun's gravity also affects the oceans. It has a smaller effect than the moon, because the sun is much further away. As the Earth turns, a place moves through two bulges and the lower water between them. So most coasts get two high tides and two low tides each day.

a tide with a very high high tide and a very low low tide. It happens when the sun and moon line up with the Earth, so their effects on the oceans add together. It has nothing to do with the season of spring.
draft.remember: The moon has the biggest effect on tides. When the sun and moon line up, their effects combine to make spring tides.

a.q: Which is the main cause of tides in the oceans?
opts: The pull of the moon's gravity on the oceans
The pull of the sun's gravity on the oceans
Winds blowing the water towards the coast
The Earth's tilt as it moves around the sun
a.why: The moon's gravity makes the oceans bulge, and these bulges are high tides. The sun's gravity also affects tides, but its effect is smaller because the sun is much further away.
a.clue: Which object has the bigger effect because it is much closer?

b.q: At a beach on Port Phillip Bay, the sun, Earth and moon line up and the tide range is the biggest of the month. What type of tide is this?
opts: A spring tide, because the sun and moon's effects combine
A spring tide, because it happens in the season of spring
A weak tide, because the sun works against the moon
A weak tide, because the sun's pull cancels the moon's
b.why: When the sun and moon line up with the Earth, their effects on the oceans add together. This gives a very high high tide and a very low low tide, called a spring tide. The name has nothing to do with the season of spring.
b.clue: Think about what lining up does to the sun's and moon's effects.

a.best: The pull of the moon's gravity on the oceans

b.best: A spring tide, because the sun and moon's effects combine
